1. (Currently Amended) A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, the method comprising:
a. providing a finger palette including:
i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and
ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion, __wherein the surface portion is configured to be removable and replaceable__;
b. the method including the steps of:
i. securing the finger palette to a finger;
ii. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and
iii. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination, __wherein the cosmetic product is transferred using an applicator tool separate from the finger palette__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein:
a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and
b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, __wherein the first quantity and second quantity are controlled by the user through selective application of the cosmetic product using an applicator__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein:
a. the surface portion extends outwardly from a surface center to an outer perimeter; and
b. the surface portion is free, from any first point on the outer perimeter to any second point on the outer perimeter, of features that could trap cosmetics and complicate cleaning of the surface portion, __and wherein the surface portion is configured to be cleaned by wiping with a cloth or tissue without residue accumulation__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially without protrusions extending therefrom, __and wherein the surface portion is configured such that cosmetic product does not accumulate in crevices during use__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar, __and wherein the planar surface is maintained during repeated applications and removals of cosmetic product__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion, __and wherein the ring portion is removably and replaceably securable to allow for replacement of the surface portion__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further including the step of __selectively removing a desired amount of the cosmetic product from the container using a separate applicator tool before depositing the cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette, wherein the removal step allows for controlled portioning of the cosmetic product__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein:
a. the cosmetic product is a first cosmetic product; and
b. the method further includes the step of depositing a second cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette, __wherein the first and second cosmetic products are from different containers and are deposited sequentially onto different regions of the surface portion__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein:
a. the first cosmetic product is deposited on a first segment of the surface portion; and
b. the second cosmetic product is deposited on a non-overlapping second segment of the surface portion, __and wherein the first and second segments are maintained separately on the surface portion prior to blending__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 further including the step of __manually blending the first cosmetic product with the second cosmetic product on the surface portion using a blending tool to obtain a blended cosmetic product__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 14 further including the step of transferring the blended cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to the destination, __wherein the blended cosmetic product is transferred using a separate applicator tool__.

18. (Currently Amended) A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a work surface, the method comprising:
a. providing a finger palette including:
i. a ring portion configured to be removably and replaceably securable to a finger; and
ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion extending outwardly from a surface center to an outer perimeter, wherein the surface portion is at least substantially smooth so as to allow a user to scrape an applicator past the surface center in an uninterrupted motion while spreading or blending cosmetic product over the entirety of the surface portion, __and wherein the surface portion is configured to be replaced independent of the ring portion__;
b. the method including the steps of:
i. securing the finger palette to a finger by passing the finger through the ring portion;
ii. dispensing cosmetic product from a cosmetics container and placing a first quantity of the dispensed cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette __using a first applicator tool__;
iii. removing cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette __using a second applicator tool__; and
iv. applying a second quantity of the removed cosmetic product to a destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, __wherein the second applicator tool is used to apply the cosmetic product to the work surface__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein:
a. the dispensed cosmetic product is a first cosmetic product dispensed from a first cosmetics container; and
b. the method further includes the steps of:
i. dispensing a second cosmetic product from a second cosmetics container and placing a third quantity of the dispensed second cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette __on a non-overlapping region from the first cosmetic product__; and
ii. blending the first cosmetic product on the surface portion with the second cosmetic product on the surface portion using a blending tool to obtain a blended cosmetic product, wherein the cosmetic product applied to the destination is the blended cosmetic product __and is applied using the second applicator tool__.
